title: 2027 Web Platform Feature Ranking
summary: A web platform feature ranking website that tracks and visualizes browser interoperability scores for various web platform features, helping developers understand cross-browser compatibility status.
problem_solved: Helps web developers quickly identify which web platform features have strong cross-browser support and which still have interoperability issues.
why_valuable: Provides a centralized, ranked view of browser compatibility data that saves developers hours of research when deciding which web APIs to use.
